name: Luto Essentials Hoodie
description: The Luto Essentials Hoodie is crafted from premium heavyweight cotton for ultimate warmth and comfort. Its relaxed fit and minimalist design make it a versatile staple for any wardrobe. Features include a double-lined hood, ribbed cuffs, and a spacious kangaroo pocket.

name: Minimalist Chrono Watch
description: A timeless piece of precision engineering. The Minimalist Chrono Watch features a sleek matte black dial, surgical-grade stainless steel casing, and a genuine Italian leather strap. Water-resistant up to 50 meters, it seamlessly blends durability with understated elegance.

name: Urban Explorer Backpack
description: Designed for the modern commuter, the Urban Explorer Backpack offers smart organization and weather resistance. It features a padded 15-inch laptop sleeve, hidden anti-theft pockets, and ergonomic shoulder straps for all-day comfort. Built from durable, water-repellent nylon.

name: Cloud Step Sneakers
description: Experience weightless movement with the Cloud Step Sneakers. Engineered with a proprietary foam midsole that absorbs impact, and a breathable knit upper that conforms to your foot. Perfect for both high-intensity workouts and casual city strolls.

name: Structured Trench Coat
description: A modern take on a classic silhouette. The Structured Trench Coat is tailored from a premium water-resistant gabardine blend. It features sharp lapels, an adjustable waist tie to define your shape, and deep functional pockets. Effortlessly elevates any outfit.

name: Classic Silk Blouse
description: Luxuriously soft and beautifully draped, the Classic Silk Blouse is a must-have for elegant dressing. Made from 100% pure Mulberry silk, it offers a subtle sheen and a relaxed yet refined fit. Perfect for transitioning from office wear to evening elegance.
